name: Nox
overview: A dark Jellyfin theme inspired by modern streaming UIs.
description: Nox retints Jellyfin Web from a single token layer: near-black page, a raised surface for cards and dialogs, muted blue-grey secondary text, an accent driven by one custom property, rounded posters with a hover shadow, gradient-scrimmed heroes, blurred sticky header, and restrained motion. Includes a bridge to Jellyfin's --jf-palette-* variables plus fourteen alternate palettes.
changelog: 0.1.0: initial release. Global base, header, home rows, cards, detail page, player OSD, dialogs, forms, login, responsive and reduced-motion coverage.
author: Nox contributors

accent.note: Change this one property to re-skin every accent surface.
